title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Solid Brass | Sea Foam Green | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a recessed toilet paper holder that saves space and creates a streamlined, built-in look in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean install: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Built to last: Brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance.
  • Ready to install: Includes recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware; no assembly required.

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Recessed
  • Overall size: 6.125 in L x 4 in W x 6.125 in H
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
